content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [company_name] [product_name] installed for my swimming pool, which is set to automatically filter from 10:00 to 20:00. I would like to update these times but I have no software or prior experience. How can I modify these settings using the LCD display? The device has arrow keys, escape, and OK buttons.
Which [product_name] model are you using? Please provide the complete article number, starting with [article_no]....

Hello [user_name], The article number [article_no] doesn't appear to be correct. Please double-check it. Whether you can make changes directly on the display depends on whether the program is unsecured, and if you are in admin mode. The programmer may have locked editing access or restricted parameters. Familiarity with the configuration blocks is important. If the configuration allows for easy changes via text display, it simplifies things for the operator. For further assistance, could you provide more details about your available options? Was an operating manual provided with the system?

[article_no] was an older [product_name], sometimes referred to as “[product_name] 24RCL”. This product can be programmed with the current [product_name] software ([version_no]), or with any earlier version greater than or equal to [version_no]. In addition, a [product_name] programming cable is required, but it is no longer available for purchase.
Here you can find the manual for [article_no]: [document]
I am aware that adjustments can be made using the LCD display; a specialist managed it last year. I will review the manual and hope it is understandable.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces difficulty when trying to adjust timer settings via the LCD interface on their [company_name] [product_name], due to lack of experience and absence of software. Other users clarify product details, discuss configuration restrictions and security modes, and reference documentation and tools needed for changes. The process is somewhat complex for newcomers because of administrative locks and limited step-by-step instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to easily update timer parameters using the LCD display alone, without programming knowledge or additional equipment.
